Game Overview

In Toxic Ride, the core idea is straightforward: experience the thrill of Toxic Ride as you dodge traffic and unleash your turbo boost. Navigate dangerous highways, collect gold, and unlock new cars, all while managing your fuel. Test your skills and see if you can reign supreme on the open road!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Toxic Ride is easy to pick up. Experience the thrill of Toxic Ride as you dodge traffic and unleash your turbo boost. Navigate dangerous highways, collect gold, and unlock new cars, all while managing your fuel. Test your skills and see if you can reign supreme on the open road!
